purpose: Independently frozen fresh evaluation requested in the review of PR 82: the submitted learner is fixed, eleven new dataset seeds are declared here, this file is committed before any draw is prepared, predictions are saved and hashed before any evaluation-label slice is opened, and all eleven counts are reported against the exact 7,370/11,000 threshold. The original evidence (protocol.json, evidence/accuracy) and its disclosed timestamp limitation are retained unchanged.
learner: QDA: class-conditional Gaussians with full per-class covariance, biased ML estimates, no shrinkage, class-frequency priors, log-determinant term; ordered FP32 arithmetic as in reference.py

config.log: 40+40 halving/doubling steps, atanh series to z^15

dataset: 1000 train and 1000 disjoint test examples from the official 60000 training images
preprocessing: float32 image/255, exact area resize to 3x3 by run.resize_recorded (repository box-area weights, increasing accumulation order, float64 product/sum before each FP32 accumulation), learner input 4*x-0.5
selection: No selection on these draws: the learner is exactly the one submitted (reference.py hash above); seeds 20262101-20262111 have never been used by the authors for any pilot, selection or evaluation (pilots used 20261101-20261110, the original evaluation 20261201-20261211, other entries 20261301+, 20261401+, 20261501+, 20261601+)
chronology: This protocol is committed to the submission branch before `run.py prepare`; the draw manifest, the prediction freeze and the evaluation each record their UTC time and are committed in that order
training: Deterministic closed form; no learner seed; no learned state transfer between draws
evaluator: Two-phase: freeze (hash predictions, no evaluation-label slices) then score (verify hashes first)
